column1: # Game profile of A Little to the Left (Switch, update 3.6.0 = v1179648, with its two DLC). Plays on the Mac and an iPhone
# Unity 2020.3.26f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 13.3.7, NVN API 55.15; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# The shaders are Unity shader objects in the player's serialized files and bundles under Data/, read by the shader split: 4,063 of them (2,001 vertex, 2,005 pixel, 56 compute, 1 geometry).
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile; stdalloc_cap and fps_target added (README.md).
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so the game takes its memory as address regions; it sets no heap. nninitStartup gives StandardAllocator the pool less what is used,
# 3.14 GB at alias +0.06 GB, and Unity's own regions come after it. In the iPhone's 4.375 GB alias region they ran past the end when Play loads the first level: the iPhone
# crashed writing 0x1fffe0 (main+0x82b7a8), the Mac with DM_ALIAS_SIZE=0x118000000 stopped on an empty screen with the high-water mark at +4.26 GB and 1.01 GB mapped.
# stdalloc_cap gives StandardAllocator 2 GB of address space instead, about twice what the game maps; the pool stays the Switch's (README.md, Memory).
# everything is under Data/: the player's serialized files and its bundles
